Title: Direct Intervention vs Referendum vs NRA

Messages.Author: galliard
Messages.Body:
We know that if action card is cancelled by DI, minion can play same action card (like Computer Hacking)
Is this the same for Political Actions?
Is the acting minion considered to have played referendum? Remember than minion can call only one referendum per turn. Please simple answer from the 3 below

1. Minion can play the same referendum from hand
2. Minion can play different referendum
3. Minion cant play referendum anymore this turn

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> galliard wrote:
> We know that if action card is cancelled by DI, minion can play same action card (like Computer Hacking)
> Is this the same for Political Actions?
> Is the acting minion considered to have played referendum? Remember than minion can call only one referendum per turn. Please simple answer from the 3 below
>
> 1. Minion can play the same referendum from hand
> 2. Minion can play different referendum
> 3. Minion cant play referendum anymore this turn
>
Political actions *are* actions. If you play Direct Intervention on your predator's Anson's Parity Shift, Anson can play another Parity Shift {action card}. The DI'd Parity Shift {action card} has been considered played (this is a pre-requirement for playing Direct Intervention).

Now, a referendum is called  when the political action is successful. So the DI'd Parity Shift was not called, snice the DI'd Parity Shift never reached resolution.

1 - Yes - the vampire who played the DI'd political action card can play the same political action card.
2 - Yes - the vampire who played the DI'd political action card can play a different political action card.
3 - No.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> galliard wrote:
> Remember than minion can call only one referendum per turn.
>
No. A minion can only perform one political action each turn.

> rulebook wrote:
> 6.1.7. Political Action (+1 stealth)
>
> A political action is an action that is used to call a referendum. It has a default +1 stealth and can only be taken by vampires (allies cannot call referendums). A political action is always undirected (see Who May Attempt to Block, sec. 6.2.2.1). A minion cannot perform more than one political action each turn.
>
This means that if the action is DIed, it wasn't performed and the minion can perform another political action; and that if the action was blocked, the minion can't perform another political action (even though the referendum wasn't called).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
> Pascal wrote:
> 1 - Yes - the vampire who played the DI'd political action card can play the same political action card.
>
I'd like to add : if it's a "once per game" political action like Ancient Influence or Reins of power (retrieved by, say, Sargon fragment or Carlotta), he cannot play that card again. It has been canceled by D.I. but played nonetheless.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body: (in short, don't confuse "play", "perform", "call", and "resolve", which each point to a specific point in the action flow)
